record.title: Introduce the specimen Ethernet link under a fresh Linux capture
record.intent: Establish one isolated lease and identity witness using the prepared standard Linux network.
requirements: Verify the recorded namespace ownership, exact wired interface, no management link/default route/forwarding and unchanged management availability. Start one fresh full Layer Two tcpdump capture with complete packets, no restrictive filter, durable raw output and recorded supervisor/PID/birth/argv ownership before cueing any cable transition. Preserve separate host and workstation clock domains and a bounded lifetime with graceful SIGINT termination.

Require explicit operator confirmation that only the scope Ethernet was connected to the dedicated bench port. Do not infer the physical transition from packets or silence. Preserve the RF coax, scope power, USB-B and RF source connections. No scope reboot, firmware, entitlement, calibration or RF setting/measurement is included.

DHCP remains inactive until that confirmation and healthy capture. Then run only the prepared namespace-bound DNS-disabled MAC-bound24h DHCP service with no router/DNS options. Require a new matching captured REQUEST/ACK before management, and preserve actual assigned address, MAC, options and timestamps. Unexpected external/update behavior or recorder failure stops the checkpoint.

After the new lease is independently checked, use one ordinary Python TCP socket connection inside the namespace to the previously established SCPI port5555. Send exactly one *IDN? newline, retain raw request/response and pcap, enforce bounded framing/time and no ambiguous retry, then stop management. No ADB, Web Control, option query, USB interaction or port/service scan is included.

Preserve actual capture closure/drop statistics, DHCP/helper ownership and cleanup, namespace state and immutable raw evidence before review. A prepared or armed capture is not physical reachability or RF qualification. Keep the Mac branch and old RF automation paused.
acceptance: One explicit link/lease/identity checkpoint is preserved or a concrete prerequisite or stop is recorded without broadening the experiment.
